name: Uberabatitan
sum: Uberabatitan is a titanosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Minas Gerais, Brazil, known from neck, back and tail vertebrae and limb bones.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; found at a road cut on BR-050 in Uberaba.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Salgado and Carvalho 2008
